build: FILL IN: installer file name and version, e.g. AI Factory-0.2.0.dmg
launchedVia: FILL IN: how the product was launched, e.g. Finder double-click on AI Factory.app, or double-click on AI Factory Setup 0.2.0.exe. Direct-binary or terminal launches do NOT count: they bypass Gatekeeper/SmartScreen by construction.
promptObserved: FILL IN: the operating system's prompt text, verbatim. Do not write around it (no bypass, no right-click Open, no spctl disable) and do not write 'no prompt' unless the OS genuinely showed nothing.
signatureStatus: FILL IN: what the trust gate reported, e.g. codesign authority present=true, spctl assess pass=true
